fib: ______ are those offences which were developed from the customs and tradition of the English people.
Common law offences
Common law offences are those offences which were developed from the customs and tradition of the English people.
______ means being in physical possession of property, while constructive possession means holding it through a servant or other agent(s).
Actual possession
Actual possession means being in physical possession of property, while constructive possession means holding it through a servant or other agent(s).
______ is the major determining factor in distinguishing between the offence of burglary and house breaking.
Time
Time is the major determining factor in distinguishing between the offence of burglary and house breaking.
______ is the act or omission done or omitted while the mental element is the intent to commit or omit the crime.
physical element
The physical element is the act or omission done or omitted while the mental element is the intent to commit or omit the crime.
______ means desire of consequence, and it could be derived from the circumstance of a particular case.
Intention
Intention means desire of consequence, and it could be derived from the circumstance of a particular case.
______ are those breaches of the law which the law forbids and also failing by way of missions to do, what the law has commanded.
Crimes
Crimes are those breaches of the law which the law forbids and also failing by way of missions to do, what the law has commanded.
______ is an authority issued by a court to a police officer to arrest an offender.
warrant of arrest
A warrant of arrest is an authority issued by a court to a police officer to arrest an offender.
